data.label: ui_screens
data.description: Chess UI: renders the 8x8 board with pieces, legal-move highlighting, status banner, move log, Reset/Undo buttons and a '3D Board' toggle with a perspective-projected canvas view. Exports render() as the app entry.

data.label: core_engine
data.description: App controller: ChessEngine facade (select/move/reset/undo/status) and InputHandler that wires DOM squares to the engine with click-to-select then click-to-move. Re-exports engine types for siblings.

data.label: input_handler
data.description: Keyboard control: arrow keys move a cursor, Enter/Space selects a piece then plays the move, Escape cancels. Works alongside the mouse InputHandler.

data.label: data_store
data.description: Game state store: owns the board, turn, move history, selection and game status; wraps the rules engine (game_engine) and exposes the shared chessEngine singleton plus addMove/updateBoard/detectCheckmate API. Supports undo via snapshots.

data.label: game_engine
data.description: Complete chess rules engine: full legal move generation (pawns, knights, bishops, rooks, queens, kings), castling with rights, en passant, pawn promotion, pin-aware king-safety filtering, check/checkmate/stalemate detection. Self-contained, no imports. Verified by tsc + 24 unit checks.
